2608.04719.title: Diagnosing Tool-Selection Reasoning in LLM Agents with Canary Tools
2608.04719.paper_summary: Agent evaluations tell us that a model picked the wrong tool, but rarely why. We introduce canary tools: diagnostic probe tools planted in an agent's Model Context Protocol (MCP) tool set, each engineered to probe one specific tool-selection weakness. A six-type taxonomy (semantic decoys, parameter traps, capability mirages, prerequisite blindness, temporal decoys, and granularity traps) turns a single "wrong tool" outcome into a multi-dimensional profile of how a model reasons about tools. We evaluate eight models -- six hosted and two 8B open-weight -- spanning three capability tiers, on 120 tasks across three canary-density conditions and three seeds (8,640 runs), plus a 2,880-run subtlety ablation. Task success is graded by a provider-independent judge, corroborated by a second independent judge (Cohen's kappa = 0.75). We report three findings. First, susceptibility drops sharply as models get more capable: the per-task canary susceptibility rate (CSR) ranges about 36x across models, lowest for Claude Opus 4.8 and highest for Llama 3.1 8B. Second, capability tier alone does not predict safety: the most susceptible hosted model is mid-tier, and within a provider the cheaper model can be the safer one. Third, the taxonomy is capability-stratified: capability mirages most reliably trap frontier models, while the other types are largely inert on strong models but fire on small open models, so they discriminate by capability rather than being weak. Softening each canary's give-away phrase leaves frontier CSR essentially unchanged, evidence that the probes measure reasoning, not phrase-spotting. Susceptibility also predicts task failure (Spearman rho = -0.34), while the most robust models are not significantly degraded by canary pressure. We release the framework, canary schemas, tasks, and logs.
2608.04719.paper_summary_zh: 代理評估告訴我們模型選擇了錯誤的工具，但很少解釋原因。我們引入了金絲雀工具：這些診斷探測工具被植入代理的模型上下文協議（MCP）工具集中，每個工具都是為了探測一個特定的工具選擇弱點而設計的。一個六類分類法（語義誘餌、參數陷阱、能力幻影、前提盲點、時間誘餌和粒度陷阱）將單一的「錯誤工具」結果轉化為模型如何推理工具的多維輪廓。我們評估了八個模型——六個託管模型和兩個8B開放權重模型——涵蓋三個能力層級，在三個金絲雀密度條件下的120個任務和三個種子（8,640次運行），以及一個2,880次運行的微妙消融。任務成功由獨立的評審進行評分，並由第二位獨立評審進行 corroboration（Cohen's kappa = 0.75）。我們報告了三個發現。首先，隨著模型能力的提高，易受攻擊性急劇下降：每個任務的金絲雀易受攻擊率（CSR）在模型之間的範圍約為36倍，Claude Opus 4.8的最低，Llama 3.1 8B的最高。第二，僅僅依賴能力層級並不能預測安全性：最易受攻擊的託管模型是中層的，而在同一提供者中，較便宜的模型可能是更安全的。第三，分類法是能力分層的：能力幻影最可靠地困住前沿模型，而其他類型在強模型上大多無效，但在小型開放模型上卻會發揮作用，因此它們是根據能力進行區分，而不是因為弱。軟化每個金絲雀的揭示短語基本上不改變前沿CSR，這證據表明探測器測量的是推理，而不是短語識別。易受攻擊性還預測了任務失敗（Spearman rho = -0.34），而最穩健的模型並未因金絲雀壓力而顯著退化。我們發布了框架、金絲雀架構、任務和日誌。
2608.04719.author: Atul Anand et.al.
